name: application-query-builder
title: Query Builder
description: Visual AND/OR condition group builder with field/operator/value rows and nested groups, driven by a typed recursive rules prop contract.
useWhen: Users need to build complex filter logic beyond a flat list of chips, including nested AND/OR grouping.
An admin or analytics tool exposes advanced search where conditions can be combined in different ways.
Each condition needs a field, operator, and value picked independently, with the ability to add or remove rows.
avoidWhen: Filters are simple and flat — use the Data Filter Bar for single-level chip filtering instead.
Most users won't need boolean grouping — a basic search box or a handful of toggles may be faster to use.
The query needs to be authored as raw text or code — a query language editor may fit better than a visual builder.
responsiveBehavior: Condition rows wrap onto multiple lines on narrow viewports via flex-wrap; nested groups remain indented with a border-left rail to preserve hierarchy at any width.
accessibility: AND/OR toggles are real buttons with aria-pressed reflecting the active combinator, not just background color.
Each remove-condition button carries an explicit aria-label since it is icon-only.
Field, operator, and value controls remain native form elements (select, input) for full keyboard and screen-reader support.

variants.title: Query Builder
variants.description: Nested condition builder with a top-level AND/OR toggle, field/operator/value rows, a nested OR sub-group, and add condition/group actions.
accessibility: The active AND/OR combinator is marked with aria-pressed in addition to its filled background.

variants.title: Query Builder (Dark)
variants.description: Query builder adapted for dark surfaces with the same combinator toggle, condition-row, and nested-group structure.
accessibility: Combinator toggle, condition-row controls, and indent-rail lines must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
